patchouli.book.tools_of_the_gods.tog_gui: Welcome, adventurer!$(br2)This guide covers crafting, tiers, traits, gems, armor, and the Ultimate Tool.$(br2)You receive one copy on first join. Right-click the guide item anytime to reopen it.

patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.welcom: Tools of the Gods adds progressive tools, armor, and traits.$(br2)Every TOG item gains XP from use, levels up to 100, and unlocks tiers with gems. Traits are bound at the $(l:traits/smithing_table)Trait Smithing Table$().$(br2)See $(l:intro/first_steps)First Steps$() to begin.

Browse categories on the left.$(br2)$(li) $(l:core_tools/pickaxe)Core Tools$() — mining and combat$(li) $(l:expanded_tools/fishing_rod)Expanded Tools$() — rod, crossbow, trident, staff, wings$(li) $(l:armor/overview)Armor of the Gods$()$(li) $(l:defense/shield)Shield$()$(li) $(l:traits/bindings)Trait Bindings$()$(li) $(l:progression/gems)Gems$()$(li) $(l:ultimate/ultimate_tool)Ultimate Tool$()
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.first_: Craft any $(item)Primal$() tool from planks and a vanilla wooden tool. Each tool levels through use.$(br2)At level 10, 20, 30… you can tier-upgrade with $(l:progression/gems)gems$() (Shift+Right-click). Reach $(#55FF55)Tier 9$() to craft the $(l:ultimate/ultimate_tool)Ultimate Tool$().
Bow caps at Tier 4 (level 50). Expanded tools and armor reach Tier 9 like other gear.$(br2)Bind traits once you have an open trait slot — see $(l:intro/tiers)Tiers & Slots$().
$(#FFD700)Tier names$()$(br)T0 Primal Wooden$(br)T1 Crude Stone$(br)T2 Hewn Iron$(br)T3 Gilded Gold$(br)T4 Lapis-Touched$(br)T5 Redstone-Forged$(br)T6 Obsidian Runed$(br)T7 Arcane Emerald$(br)T8 Ethereal Diamond$(br)T9 [Tool] of the Gods
$(#FFD700)Trait slots by tier$()$(br)T0: 0$(br)T1–2: 1$(br)T3–4: 2$(br)T5: 3$(br)T6: 4$(br)T7: 4$(br)T8: 5$(br)T9: 6$(br2)$(item)Modifiable$() adds +1 slot. Ultimate Tool has 8 base slots at T9.

$(#FFD700)Harvest capability$()$(br)T0 Wood$(br)T1 Stone$(br)T2+ Iron$(br)T8+ Diamond$(br2)One-shot ores: T5 coal, T6 stone/copper, T7 deepslate/gold, T8 iron/redstone, T9 diamond. XP scales with ore rarity.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.pickax: Breaks stone and ores; gains XP from mining (rare ores give much more). Cannot one-shot hard blocks until Tier 5+. High tiers mine layers faster.$(br2)Shift+Right-click to tier-upgrade.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.hammer: Heavy mining tool — beats pickaxe on stone damage. Supports 3×3 mine with Broad Touch. Slower attack than pickaxe. Shift+Right-click to tier-upgrade.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.axe.pa: Chops logs and fights well. Poison/Freeze on hit with traits. Broad Touch fells trees. Penalty XP on soft blocks. Shift+Right-click to tier-upgrade.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.shovel: Digs dirt, sand, gravel. Broad Touch for area digging. No melee bonus. Shift+Right-click to tier-upgrade.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.hoe.pa: Tills farmland and strips paths. Gains XP on soil use. Least combat utility. Shift+Right-click to tier-upgrade.
Combat weapon. Poison/Freeze on hit with traits. XP per enemy hit scales with mob type. Less XP from mining. Shift+Right-click to tier-upgrade.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.bow.pa: Ranged weapon. Poison/Freeze on arrow hit. 2 XP per arrow fired. Max Tier 4 (levels 0–50). Limited trait access vs other tools. Shift+Right-click to tier-upgrade.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.fishin: XP per catch. Traits: Angler I/II, Reel I, Scholar, Scavenger, Magnetic, Bountiful, and utility passives. Angler (Nautilus Shell → Heart of the Sea) improves treasure. Reel (Cod) speeds bites.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.crossb: XP on charged shot. Traits: Ranger, Marksman I/II, Quick Load I, Poison, Freezy, Frenzy, Speedy, utility. Marksman (Spectral Arrow → Arrow) boosts bolt damage. Quick Load (Firework Rocket) speeds reload.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.triden: Melee and thrown. XP on melee hits. Traits: Impaler I/II, Returning I, Riptide I, plus combat/mining traits. Impaler (Prismarine Crystals → Netherite Ingot), Returning (Ender Pearl), Riptide (Prismarine Shard).
Right-click casts a divine bolt (short cooldown). Traits: Arcane I/II, Channeling I, Scholar, utility. Arcane (Amethyst Shard → Dragon's Breath) strengthens the bolt. Channeling (Lightning Rod) calls lightning in storms.
Chest-slot glide item using Aerial material (no armor bar). XP while gliding. Traits: Aerodynamic I/II, Featherfall I, plus worn passives (Swiftstep, Bulwark, etc.). See $(l:armor/overview)Armor of the Gods$() for worn armor progression.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.armor_: Four independent pieces — helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots — each with its own level (0–100) and tier (0–9). Craft from iron armor + iron ingots. Unlimited durability; repair with $(item)Universe Gem$() at a high tier.$(br2)XP: passive while worn, faster when taking damage. $(#55FF55)Shift+Right-click$() any piece to tier-upgrade when it shows $(#FF5555)NEEDS UPGRADE$().

Each piece contributes $(#55FFFF)fractional armor points$() that stack on the armor bar. Worn look changes per tier (leather → chain → iron → gold → gems).$(br2)Read $(l:armor/progression)Defense Scaling$(), $(l:armor/tiers_upgrades)Tiers & Upgrades$(), and $(l:armor/traits)Armor Traits$().

$(#FFD700)Fractional armor$() — values like 0.5, 1.2, 2.8 (not just whole numbers). Each piece gets a share of the full-set total using vanilla leather ratios (helm 1/7, chest 3/7, legs 2/7, boots 1/7).$(br2)Full set formula: $(#AAAAAA)0.5 + (level ÷ 100) × 34.5$()$(br)Level 1 ≈ 0.8 total · Level 12 ≈ 4.6 · Level 50 ≈ 17.8 · Level 100 = $(#55FF55)35.0$()

$(#FFD700)Late-game extras$()$(br)Toughness: from level 70+ (0.5 → 3.0 by level 100).$(br)Knockback resist: from level 80+ (5% → 10%).$(br2)No full-set bonus — only per-piece stats and traits. Re-equip after major updates if the bar looks wrong.

$(#FFD700)Armor tier names$() (different from tool wood/stone names):$(br)T0 Worn Leather$(br)T1 Rusty Chainmail$(br)T2 Forged Iron$(br)T3 Gilded Leather$(br)T4 Amethyst-Touched$(br)T5 Ruby-Forged$(br)T6 Obsidian Runed$(br)T7 Arcane Emerald$(br)T8 Ethereal Diamond$(br)T9 Divine (…of the Gods)

$(#FFD700)Upgrade materials$() at level 10, 20, 30…$(br)$(#55FFFF)Armor T1:$() $(item)8 Chains$() — not cobblestone!$(br)T2–T9: same gems as tools (White → Universe).$(br2)$(#FFD700)Tools T1:$() still $(item)32 Cobblestone$(). See $(l:progression/gems)Gem Progression$().

$(#FFD700)Armor-only$() at the Trait Smithing Table:$(br2)$(#55FFFF)Thorns I$() (Cactus) — reflects 2 melee damage to attackers.$(br)$(#55FFFF)Thorns II$() — reflects 5 damage (upgrade at same table).$(br2)$(#55FFFF)Fireward I$() (Magma Cream) — Fire Resistance I while worn.$(br)$(#55FFFF)Fireward II$() (Blaze Rod upgrade) — Fire Resistance II.

$(#FFD700)Also allowed on armor$()$(br)Scholar I/II — +XP gain.$(br)Soulbound — kept on death.$(br)Modifiable I — +1 trait slot.$(br)Sustaining I/II/III — passive food (loot penalty).$(br)Bulwark I — Resistance I while worn.$(br)Swiftstep I — Speed I while worn.$(br)Purifying I — clears one negative effect periodically.

$(#FF5555)Not allowed on armor:$() Silky, Broad Touch, Momentum, Moonlit, Autosmelt, Sharpy, Titan, Ranger, Poison, Freezy, and other mining/combat-on-hit traits.$(br2)Shield traits ($(l:defense/defense_traits)Guardian / Repulse$()) bind to the $(l:defense/shield)Shield$() only.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.shield: Blocks melee and arrows while raised. Block chance rises with level (30% → 95%). Failed blocks at low level deal full damage. XP from successful blocks. Bind Guardian traits with iron block / obsidian.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.defens: Shield-only: $(#55FFFF)Guardian I/II$() (Iron Block → Obsidian) — +block chance and block power. $(#55FFFF)Repulse I$() (Piston) — knockback wave while blocking (not while sneaking).$(br2)Armor traits: see $(l:armor/traits)Armor Traits$().
Mining and on-hit combat traits cannot bind to shield or armor.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.smithi: Place a TOG item in slot 1 and one binding ingredient in slot 2, then press Apply. Right-click the block to open the UI. Some traits need a specific tool type or rank upgrade at the same table.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.bindin: $(item)Redstone Block$() → Speedy$(br)$(item)Spider Eye$() → Poison$(br)$(item)Bread$() → Sustaining$(br)$(item)Magma Block$() → Autosmelt$(br)$(item)Nether Star$() → Soulbound$(br)$(item)Iron Ingot$() → Sharpy$(br)$(item)Diamond$() → Modifiable$(br)$(item)Copper Ingot$() → Magnetic$(br)$(item)String$() → Silky$(br)$(item)Ice$() → Freezy

$(item)Sugar$() → Momentum$(br)$(item)Slime Ball$() → Broad Touch$(br)$(item)Blaze Powder$() → Frenzy$(br)$(item)Anvil$() → Titan$(br)$(item)Lapis Lazuli$() → Scholar$(br)$(item)Phantom Membrane$() → Moonlit$(br)$(item)Flint$() → Ranger (Bow)$(br)$(item)Emerald$() → Bountiful$(br)$(item)Hopper$() → Scavenger$(br)$(item)Glowstone$() → Purifying$(br)$(item)Feather$() → Swiftstep$(br)$(item)Brick$() → Bulwark

$(item)Cactus$() → Thorns (armor)$(br)$(item)Magma Cream$() → Fireward I (armor)$(br)$(item)Blaze Rod$() → Fireward II$(br)$(item)Iron Block$() → Guardian I (shield)$(br)$(item)Obsidian$() → Guardian II$(br)$(item)Piston$() → Repulse (shield)
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.trait_: $(#FFD700)Speedy$() (Redstone Block) — atk/mine speed up, damage & XP down. Ranks I–III.$(br2)$(#FFD700)Poison / Freezy$() — on-hit effects; Axe, Sword, Bow.$(br2)$(#FFD700)Sustaining$() (Bread) — passive food; loot penalty.$(br2)$(#FFD700)Autosmelt / Silky$() — smelt or silk touch; rank II toggle with sneak+use.

$(#FFD700)Sharpy / Titan$() — flat damage; Axe & Sword.$(br2)$(#FFD700)Momentum$() (Sugar) — ramping mine speed after consecutive blocks.$(br2)$(#FFD700)Broad Touch$() (Slime) — 3×3 / 5×5 / tree felling by tool.$(br2)$(#FFD700)Frenzy$() (Blaze Powder) — speed without Speedy's XP penalty tradeoff.

$(#FFD700)Scholar$() — +XP. $(#FFD700)Moonlit$() — night mining speed. $(#FFD700)Ranger$() — bow handling.$(br2)$(#FFD700)Soulbound$() — kept on death. $(#FFD700)Modifiable$() — +1 trait slot. $(#FFD700)Magnetic / Scavenger / Bountiful$() — loot QoL.$(br2)$(#FFD700)Purifying / Swiftstep / Bulwark$() — effect while held or worn.

$(#FFD700)Thorns / Fireward$() — $(l:armor/traits)Armor Traits$(). $(#FFD700)Guardian / Repulse$() — $(l:defense/defense_traits)Shield Traits$(). Expanded tool traits — $(l:traits/expanded_traits)Expanded Tool Traits$().
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.expand: $(#FFD700)Fishing$() — Angler I/II (Nautilus → Heart of the Sea), Reel I (Cod).$(br2)$(#FFD700)Crossbow$() — Marksman I/II (Spectral Arrow → Arrow), Quick Load I (Firework Rocket).$(br2)$(#FFD700)Trident$() — Impaler I/II, Returning I, Riptide I.

$(#FFD700)Staff$() — Arcane I/II (Amethyst → Dragon's Breath), Channeling I (Lightning Rod).$(br2)$(#FFD700)Wings$() — Aerodynamic I/II, Featherfall I (see trait upgrade items in creative tab).$(br2)$(#FFD700)Ultimate$() — Adaptive I (Compass): auto-picks tool mode from target block.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.gems.p: Shift+Right-click when $(#FF5555)NEEDS UPGRADE$():$(br2)$(#FFD700)Tools T1:$() 32 Cobblestone$(br)T2: White Gem · T3: Yellow · T4: Purple · T5: Red · T6: Black · T7: Green · T8: Blue · T9: Universe Gem$(br2)$(#FFD700)Armor T1:$() $(item)8 Chains$() — then same gems as tools (T2–T9).
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.ultima: Combines all seven core tools at Tier 9 with a Universe Gem. All tool functions in one item; up to 8 trait slots at T9.$(br2)Shift+Right-click cycles power modes (Balanced / Precision / Overdrive). Press $(k:key.tools_of_the_gods.ultimate_mode_wheel) for the mode wheel.

The wheel switches between pickaxe, hammer, axe, shovel, hoe, sword, bow, crossbow, trident, staff, and fishing rod modes. Bind $(#55FFFF)Adaptive I$() (Compass) to auto-select mode from what you target.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.mode_w: Hold the Ultimate Tool and press $(k:key.tools_of_the_gods.ultimate_mode_wheel) to open the radial selector. Click a segment to set the active tool mode.
Adaptive I (ultimate-only, Compass at Trait Smithing Table) watches what you look at and switches modes automatically — pickaxe for stone, axe for logs, sword for mobs, etc.
patchouli.entry.tools_of_the_gods.guide_: Lost your guide? Craft Book + Paper (shapeless). You also receive one copy on first join to this world.
